summary: Hyukjin Kwon is running a trial of an AI code review bot for new Apache Spark pull requests, using Claude to analyze diffs and post inline comments without approving or LGTM. The bot triggers on new commits, respects open review comments, and can be disabled per PR via an `ai-review-requested` label, with safeguards against excessive Jira API calls. The proposal introduces a unified API and execution protocol for user-defined functions (UDFs) that can run across multiple programming languages in Spark Connect, enabling external workers via inter-process communication (IPC). The discussion centers on whether Spark should support type expansion for VARCHAR columns, with the user expressing willingness to work on a solution.
